form.indexedHint: Adds a JSON-path index for filtering. A PHI field can never be indexed.

problems.phiIndexed: A PHI field cannot be indexed: the index would store the value in plaintext, outside the encryption layer (L10).
problems.phiNotEnabled: This lab does not have PHI mode on, so a PHI field cannot be defined here.
problems.enumValuesRequired: A choice list needs at least one allowed value.
problems.enumValuesDuplicated: Two allowed values are the same.
problems.rangeInverted: The minimum is above the maximum.
problems.requiredDropped: {{label}} ({{origin}}) is required; a child field cannot drop that rule.
problems.constraintDropped: {{label}} ({{origin}}) sets {{constraint}}; a child field cannot drop it.
problems.constraintWidened: {{label}} ({{origin}}) limits this field to {{constraint}}; a child field cannot go beyond it.
problems.dataTypeChanged: The data type of {{label}} ({{origin}}) is fixed; a child field cannot change it.
problems.scopeChanged: The scope of {{label}} ({{origin}}) is fixed; a child field cannot change it.
problems.phiDropped: {{label}} ({{origin}}) is marked as PHI; a child field cannot unmark it.
